dialogue_texts: Oof... okay! I give! Your magic is way more dazzling than any harvest moon!
A pleasant way to pass a few minutes. Now, point me toward the mansion near Yumemura.
The air is becoming positively suffocating.
Just follow the reddest maple leaves toward Yumemura. But be careful, eh?
The "glohm" is thicker there - it's like the world is closing its eyes.
Is the world closing its eyes? How poetic. It seems it's time for an Empress to open them.
Try not to trip over your own wings while I'm gone.
